title: Personal performance signalboard Q2 2026
linked_artifacts: CONFLUENCE: People Ops FY26 Q2 priorities (conf:/people-ops/fy26-q2)
body:
Purpose
---
Quick scratchpad for mid-year check-in / manager prep. Less formal than the review doc — used to capture raw signals, short anecdotes, ask list, and a 2-minute narrative I can read in the 1:1.

What I want this doc to do
- Give me a compact signalboard (quant + qual) to use in the 1:1 and self-review.
- Capture open asks and blockers to escalate.
- Keep a running list of micro-evidence I can paste into the formal review later.

Top-level goals (FY26, mapped to team OKRs)
1) Stabilize hiring funnel for Eng-Platform roles (OKR: reduce time-to-fill from 52 -> 32 days)
   - Workstreams: revamp job descriptions (POPS-412), prioritize sourcing channels, run 2-week recruiter blitz.
   - Signal: average time-to-screened for matched candidates dropped from 12d -> 9d after new JD push (Feb). Need more data for consistency.
2) Improve onboarding completion rate for Dedicated/Private support engineers (OKR: onboarding completion 90% within first 30d)
   - Launched new onboarding checklist + pairing rotations (pilot with 3 hires).
   - Signal: pilot cohort completion = 83% (n=6) — close but not hit. Main blocker: shadowing slots inconsistent.
3) Mentorship / career laddering: run 1 cohort of promotion-readiness workshops (OKR: 1 cohort Q2)
   - Signal: workshop scheduled; 12 attendees signed up.

Concrete signals / evidence (raw)
- Hiring: 4 offers accepted in Feb/Mar (2 Platform Eng, 1 Observability, 1 SRE), acceptance rate 67% (small n).
- Onboarding: 2x shadowing sessions missed due to team bandwidth (log: slack thread #onboarding Feb 18).
- Ops: automated ATS candidate tagging reduced manual triage by ~4 hours/week (estimate, from recruiter notes).
- Career: ran mock calibration exercise with Eng Managers (Feb 24). Feedback: need clearer rubric for IC3->IC4.

Anecdotes / quick sentences to use in review
- "Led a focused effort on the Eng Platform hiring funnel: rewrote JDs, coordinated a recruiter blitz, and implemented ATS tagging that reclaimed ~4 hours/week for recruiters."
- "Piloted a more structured onboarding path — completion for the pilot cohort was 83%, with clear signals that pairing slots are the main friction point."
- "Organized an informal calibration session with 8 managers to validate the promotion rubric; follow-up is to translate feedback into concrete examples for each level."

Risks / calibration issues to surface
- Hiring metrics are still noisy (small sample size). Need at least one more month of data before claiming steady improvement.
- Onboarding: capacity risk — if teams cannot dedicate pairing time, metric will not improve. Consider protected pairing hours in first 30d.
- Perception risk: managers want faster signals on promotion readiness; need to publish a single-page rubric + example statements.

Draft manager asks (short bullets)
- Support to carve out 3x 2-hour blocks per week across Eng-Platform for pairing during next hire ramp.
- Sign-off to run a recruiter-paid sourcing pilot (budget ask ~$6k) for two priority roles.
- Introduce the promotion rubric as a discussion item on the next Eng Leads sync so we get alignment at scale.

Draft self-review snippets (to paste into form)
- "In Q2 I focused on improving hiring and onboarding for platform teams. Results: introduced ATS tagging that reduced manual triage, rewrote 6 role descriptions, and ran a pilot onboarding flow that achieved 83% completion for the first cohort. I led cross-functional coordination between recruiting, hiring managers, and SRE to speed up time-to-screen. Next steps: scale pairing capacity and run a sourcing pilot to validate channels."

Short-term actions (next 30 days)
- Finalize JD templates and push to careers page (owner: me, due 2026-03-10).
- Run paired onboarding schedule for two new hires (owners: hiring managers + me) and record no-shows; escalate if >1 missed slot per hire.
- Prepare budget pitch for sourcing pilot and share with manager by 2026-03-05.
- Convert calibration feedback into a 1-pager rubric draft (due 2026-03-12).

Longer-term items / wishlist (nice to have)
- Protected pairing time policy (HR+ENG ops collaboration).
- Quarterly calibration playbook (templates, evidence checklist).
- Small cohort of rotating mentors to reduce onboarding variability.

Open questions / stuff to research
- Which sourcing channel yielded the 2 hires last month? (tracker: recruiter notes, need to pull analytics from Lever).
- How to quantify onboarding 'quality' beyond completion (CSAT pulse or technical task pass rates?)

Notes to self (one-liners)
- Keep the narrative concrete: numbers first, then context, then ask.
- When presenting to manager, start with the signalboard (1 slide / 3 bullets).
- Capture dates of key events in the formal review doc (offers, pilot start/end).

Links / refs to paste later
- Confluence: conf:/people-ops/onboarding-pilot/2026-q1 (notes + checklist)
- JIRA: POPS-412 (JD revamp), POPS-447 (pairing schedule infra)
- Slack threads: #onboarding, #people-ops-hiring (Feb 12 - Mar 1 snapshots)

End of scratchpad — will prune and move salient bits to the official self-review file once signals are less noisy.
